generation.explanation: Picture x² as a square, and split 6x into two strips of area 3x, each with width 3. Placing these along two sides leaves a 3 × 3 corner missing; adding its area, 9, makes a square with side x + 3. Therefore x² + 6x + 9 = (x + 3)², so x² + 6x = (x + 3)² − 9.
